resolutions.researcher_notes: This row is Package 1 (Western Region / Western gas pipeline) of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 2 (MGS-2): 422 km of 56" pipeline on East-West Pipeline 2. DMS Projects lists project Status = 'Completed', client Saudi Aramco. Blackridge Research: 'EPC works were completed in 2021, increasing the MGS's gas handling and transport capacity from 8.4 bcf/d to 12.5 bcf/d.' Two independent aggregators confirm the line is built/completed, supporting Status = operating. Original current_ref (lamar-industrial.com) was dead.

StartYear1 = 2021 supported by Blackridge Research: 'MGS-2 ... EPC works were completed in 2021.' Same completion-in-2021 statement appears in MEED reporting (paywalled, not citable). DMS Projects corroborates 'Completed' status but does not print a year, so only one verifiable source carries the 2021 value -> medium.

METenders package breakdown: 'Package 1: Western gas pipeline ... construction of 422 kilometers of 56" pipeline on East West Pipeline 2. Estimated budget is just over $827 million.' GEM SegmentCost = USD 820,000,000. VALUE DISCREPANCY to flag: source says ~$827M vs GEM $820M (~0.9% off) -- same underlying estimate, GEM appears rounded/earlier. Only one source gives a per-package figure (Blackridge/MEED report a $1.3bn total for the three main packages, not the Package-1 line item), so medium.

Owner1 = Aramco 100%. DMS Projects lists client Saudi Aramco; METenders and Blackridge describe the entire Master Gas System Expansion Phase 2 as an Aramco (owner/operator) project on Aramco's own East-West Pipeline network. Aramco is the sole owner of the MGS trunk system -> high confidence, multiple independent confirmations.
